title: Contents

location.series: IBM Logo and Brand Guidelines for Third Parties / copyright 2022

slide_intent: Make the rules easy to locate, because designers need to find the relevant condition before producing an application.
strategic_value: A concise numbered index can make IBM’s third-party guidance easier to use during production and review.
demonstration: A left-aligned Contents label sits beside a vertical list of topics and page numbers 04 through 16.
practical_value: Navigate directly to placement, color, merchandise or review guidance for the intended use.

content_islands.name: Contents label
content_islands.spec: Place the short heading at the top left.

content_islands.name: Page-topic list
content_islands.spec: Align page numbers in a narrow column beside the 13 topic labels, from trademark usage through creative review.

reference_purposes.Application: The page provides a numbered route to the guide’s usage rules and examples.
